name: Tundra Trading Station
description: Exchange items you do not need for Trade Vouchers, or spend Trade Vouchers on other items at the Trading Station.
requirements: Gen-2 hero widgets. Open the crate first, then select the specific hero widget.
Universal Shards and Expedition or Exploration Manuals for Rare and Epic heroes.
Specific hero shards only if the hero is at 5 stars before the event starts.
Heroes do not need to be fully maxed to exchange materials.

phases.name: Exchange
phases.description: Exchange eligible items for Trade Vouchers.

phases.name: Redeem
phases.description: Redeem Trade Vouchers for rewards in the shop.

rewards.name: Trade Voucher
rewards.note: For each shard. The wiki lists 100, 150, 200, or 250 depending on the hero.

tiers.name: Exchange: hero shard from the 3 newest generations

tips: Focus on Intel missions and stay active.
Get Lucky Wheel heroes to 5 stars for additional tickets.
Redeemed items do not count toward consumption missions.
Widget chest rewards vary by server generation.
Every exchange has a stock limit, and the specific hero shard exchanges show 500 of 500 in stock.
Each shop offer has a stock limit shown as Left. The widget chests, pet resources, and widget exchanges change by server generation.
The exchange rows for Universal Shards and Expedition and Exploration Manuals are shown as icons only on the wiki, so their ticket amounts are not loaded.
Exchanged items do not count toward consumption missions.
